cold-scan-index.description: Full walk with metadata into a complete index. No snapshot.

cold-scan-producer.description: Walk and metadata only, no index build. The measured component hashes the exact records emitted by the producer for independent validation.

cold-snapshot-save.description: Serialize a populated index. Wall includes the untimed setup scan.

warm-revalidate.description: Load a compatible snapshot and reconcile it against the tree. component_ns is reconciliation; wall_ns is the whole warm start.

warm-snapshot-load.description: Deserialize a snapshot into a usable index. No filesystem walk.
